title: Suzu Senbon
body:
Syntax: perform suzu senbon <target>

Description: Bell sounds that can disrupt the target's accuracy.  Ringing bells impair accuracy. Usable with any chakra nature. Base damage: 91-107. 65% chance to inflict ringing. The effect lasts 10 seconds before resistance. Unlocks at level 36. Costs 32 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
